programs.title: Wonderfully Beautiful
programs.desc: Following five very different women and their daunting task of finding out what beauty is all about. As mothers, daughters and girlfriends, the women search for new body awareness and self confidence.

programs.title: The Tunnel (Part 1)
programs.desc: In 1961 Berlin, athlete Harry escapes East Germany but his sister Lotte is trapped. He leads a daring tunnel-digging rescue under the Wall, racing against guards in a tense fight for freedom.

programs.title: Discovering Film
programs.desc: Some of the biggest film stars in history rose to fame during the `golden age' of Hollywood, in the early and mid-20th century.  We profile some of these stars who became household names.

programs.title: Mr. Holmes
programs.desc: Long after retiring, Sherlock Holmes is still being haunted by an unsolved case from fifty years earlier. Without his trusty sidekick Watson, Holmes must face the toughest case of his life.

programs.title: Lucky You
programs.desc: A poker player (Eric Bana) tries balancing a love affair with his aim for a slot in the world championship game.

programs.title: Point Break
programs.desc: A rookie FBI agent goes undercover in the surfing world to investigate a group of extreme surfers suspected of being involved in a series of bank robberies.

programs.title: Six Minutes To Midnight
programs.desc: Influential families in 1939 Nazi Germany send their daughters to an English finishing school, where an undercover British agent poses as a teacher. Stars Judi Dench and Eddie Izzard.

programs.title: Suffragette
programs.desc: The story of the foot soldiers of the early feminist movement - women who were forced underground to pursue a dangerous game of cat and mouse with an increasingly brutal State.

programs.title: Munich
programs.desc: Based on the true story of the Black September terror attack, about the five men chosen to assassinate the ones responsible for that fateful day at the 1972 Munich Olympic Games.

programs.title: Vai
programs.desc: Vai is a feature film made by nine female Pacific filmmakers, filmed in seven different Pacific countries - Fiji, Tonga, Solomon Islands, Kuki Airani (Cook Islands), Samoa, Niue and New Zealand.
